checks.name: Python
checks.repair: Re-extract or reinstall the complete official application package into a user-owned folder. Keep its bundled editor resources together; no Python installation or symbolic links are required.

checks.name: Free disk space
checks.repair: Extract the complete portable package onto a user-owned volume with enough free space for application and projects.

checks.name: ADB
checks.detail: Selected ADB executable is missing or not executable
checks.repair: Download official Android SDK platform-tools from https://developer.android.com/tools/releases/platform-tools, extract them, and choose adb/adb.exe in Settings. ADB is optional for Demo Mode.

checks.name: scrcpy server
checks.detail: 3.1 server missing or checksum does not match
checks.repair: Choose the official scrcpy 3.1 server from its trusted distribution in Settings; the application verifies its pinned checksum. Optional for Demo Mode.

checks.name: Optional OCR
checks.detail: /usr/bin/tesseract: /tmp/aas delivered portable with spaces/AndroidAutomationStudio/_internal/libstdc++.so.6: version `GLIBCXX_3.4.32' not found (required by /usr/bin/tesseract)
checks.repair: Choose a local Tesseract executable in Settings. No engine/models are downloaded automatically.

recorder: studio controls; timestamps; pre-tap evidence; saved image conversion; JSON v1/v2/v3; trusted replay
simulation: explicit opt-in; 3 stateful scenarios; separate transport; no Android hardware verification

ocr.engine: optional local Tesseract TSV; no downloads

failure_inspection: typed advice, persistent history, source navigation; explicit read-only recovery policies
debugger: worker-local bdb; private JSON pipes; breakpoint/step/stack/bounded variables; no evaluation console
scheduler: SQLite decisions/history; manual/once/interval/daily/weekly; session-only exact-source approval
projects: versioned manifest; atomic metadata; search; guarded backup/export/import; no automatic execution
connection_diagnostics: staged ADB/query/screenshot/video checks; physical device required for final stages
